goal: Check and test my ceiling smoke detector

plan.title: Check and test ceiling smoke detector
plan.summary: Visually inspect, sound-test, clean, and replace battery if needed on battery-powered ceiling smoke detector using a ladder safely.

steps.title: Prepare area
steps.instruction: Clear the floor under the detector. Check the detector label for battery type so you have the correct replacement ready. Warn others you will sound the alarm.

steps.title: Set ladder safely
steps.instruction: Place a step ladder on flat level floor directly under the detector. Lock the spreaders and face the ladder. Keep 3 points of contact when climbing.

cautions.text: Ladder can tip if floor is uneven or cluttered.

stopIf: ladder wobbles or locks do not hold

steps.title: Inspect detector visually
steps.instruction: From the ladder, look at the detector without removing it. Note the indicator light, test button, and any dust, yellowing, or damage.

cautions.text: Do not overreach from ladder, keep hips inside rails.

stopIf: housing is cracked melted or hanging loose

steps.title: Test alarm sound
steps.instruction: Press and hold the test button for 3 to 5 seconds until the alarm sounds, then release. Confirm you hear a loud beeping pattern.

cautions.text: Alarm is very loud, cover ears or wear ear protection.
Keep balance while reaching to press button.

stopIf: alarm sounds weak or stops quickly

check.whatDoneLooksLike: Finger on test button with detector on ceiling

steps.title: Check and replace battery
steps.instruction: If test was weak or low-battery chirp was heard, twist or unclip detector as marked, open battery cover, and replace battery with type shown on product label. Wipe dust off cover with soft dry cloth.

cautions.text: Do not twist or pull detector hard, support it with one hand.

stopIf: battery contacts are corroded or leaking
detector is dated over 10 years old

steps.title: Remount and retest
steps.instruction: Remount detector on ceiling base, press test button again to confirm loud alarm, then climb down and put ladder away.

cautions.text: Alarm is very loud on retest.

check.whatDoneLooksLike: Detector mounted on ceiling with indicator light visible

question: What's the next step
answer: You're still on step one, Prepare area. Clear the floor under that ceiling detector and warn others you'll sound the alarm. Point the camera up at the detector so we can check its label for battery type. Don't climb or touch anything yet.
